task.title: Understanding user interface – mobile application
task.shortdesc: The home page of the SMS mobile application provides various intuitive navigation elements.

li.p: The home page of the SMS mobile application provides various intuitive navigation elements.
The user interface consists of the following components:
Figure Home page of the SMS mobile app

row.entry: Displays an interactive doughnut pie chart that visually represents the health status of the motors using color-coded status indicators. You can tap each color to view the number of motors in a specific status. Allows you to commission a new SMS device.
Displays an alphabetical list of all motors along with their corresponding health status. You can tap each list item to view detailed health status of the selected motor.
Allows you to monitor and manage motor health in Graph view and List view.
Allows you to navigate to a specific motor by selecting its corresponding location, process, and plant and commission a new SMS device or add a motor.
Allows you to generate and view reports about specific motors.
Allows you to view any alerts that you have received about changes in motor status.

Allows you to access the Network Validator tool to test your network setup add network profiles change email and push notification settings modify language settings and preferred unit of measurement export logs reset sensor reset SMS mobile app access the FAQ document, privacy statement, and license agreement.
